newsitem.title: USA: Wyser-Pratte seeks COMSAT annual meeting by June 9.
newsitem.headline: Wyser-Pratte seeks COMSAT annual meeting by June 9.

text.p: Wyser-Pratte and Co Inc and Providence Capital Inc said Thursday that they would be willing to drop their solicitation to call a special meeting of COMSAT Corp shareholders if the company agrees to hold its 1997 annual meeting by June 9, and to eliminate the voting limitations on holders owning more than five percent of COMSAT's common shares.
The two companies said that they wanted a reply from COMSAT by 1700 EDT/2100 GMT, April 11.
A spokeswoman from COMSAT said that it had received the letter from Wyser-Pratte with the request for the meeting changes, but that no date has yet been set for the annual meeting.
The spokesoman added that COMSAT directors would review the letter along with a recent proxy filing from Wyser-Pratte and would reply in the "near future."
She declined to comment on the Wyser-Pratte request for a reply by the date named.
